summary: The filing is an 8-K reporting entry into a Second Amendment to an existing credit agreement between Silvercrest Asset Management Group subsidiaries and City National Bank. The amendment extends the term loan maturity to June 18, 2029, with two one-year extension options, sets the term loan draw deadline to June 18, 2028, and establishes a $5.0 million term loan commitment. A $10.0 million revolving credit facility matures June 18, 2027. The registrant's role is as borrower/guarantor. It represents a routine credit facility amendment and does not constitute a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring.
